title: System1-Arena: Which Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
abstract: arXiv:2610.21244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often make discrete decisions, such as flagging phishing or escalating to a human. System-1 models, such as Jev and the OpenAI Decisions API, return probabilities over options in a single forward pass, while System-2 approaches generate reasoning steps. Which decisions can System-1 models handle, and which require generative reasoning? We introduce System1-Arena, a benchmark that gives all models the same decision requests and scores their probabilities. It contains 92k questions across 105 tasks from 268 public sources, in four groups: text classification and knowledge, applied decisions, evaluation and control, and agent and action. It also includes 138 closed-loop environments, from web shopping and SWE-bench coding control to robotics, games, and driving; in real-time mode, the world evolves while a model decides. translated_title: System1-Arena：哪些决策可以交给系统1？
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）经常需要做出离散决策，例如标记网络钓鱼或将问题升级给人工处理。系统1模型（如Jev和OpenAI Decisions API）在单次前向传播中返回各选项的概率，而系统2方法则通过生成推理步骤来决策。哪些决策系统1模型可以处理，哪些又需要生成式推理？我们提出了System1-Arena，这是一个基准测试，它向所有模型提供相同的决策请求，并根据其输出的概率进行评分。该基准包含来自268个公开来源的105个任务共92k个问题，分为四大类：文本分类与知识、应用决策、评估与控制、以及智能体与行动。它还包括138个闭环环境，涵盖网络购物、SWE-bench编程控制、机器人、游戏和驾驶等领域；在实时模式下，世界会在模型进行决策的同时持续演化。我们评估了30个模型：7个闭源LLM、13个在答案token位置读取概率的开源LLM，以及10个系统……
tldr: 提出System1-Arena基准，通过在105个任务、92k个问题上统一评测系统1（单次前向传播输出概率）与系统2（生成式推理）模型，并结合138个闭环环境，系统性地回答哪些决策可以放心交给系统1模型。
en_tdlr: System1-Arena is a benchmark with 92k questions across 105 tasks and 138 closed-loop environments that uniformly scores System-1 models (single-pass probability outputs) against System-2 generative-reasoning models to determine which decisions can be safely delegated to System 1.
